newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: KURO APARATURA 1Q NET PROFIT, SALES DOWN.
newsitem.headline: KURO APARATURA 1Q NET PROFIT, SALES DOWN.

text.p: Lithuanian tractor parts producer Kuro Aparatura said on Friday its net profit and sales fell sharply in the first quarter of 1997 compared to the corresponding period last year.
"Our net profit in the first quarter of 1997 dropped to 207,730 litas from 6.9 million litas in the same period last year," the company's director of finances, Dalia Zhilinskaite, told Reuters.
"Our sales also dipped to 20.6 million litas in the first quarter of this year versus 41 million litas a year before," Zhilinskaite added.
The company exports 90 percent of its products to CIS countries and many of its customers fail to pay their debts on time.
Zhilinskaite saw little optimism for the second quarter.
"The consumers' debts of 50 million litas have not fallen from the end of the 1996 and our main task is get the debts repaid," Zhilinskaite said.
The company is listed on the A group of the Vilnius bourse.
